name: time-picker
title: TimePicker
description: A time of day typed into hour, minute, optional second and AM/PM segments, on Base UI's Input: the arrow keys step a segment and digits fill it, in three sizes.
usage: Use TimePicker for a time of day (a backup schedule, a maintenance window). Put it in a Field after a FieldLabel. The value is "HH:mm" ("HH:mm:ss" with seconds) on the 24-hour clock whatever hourCycle shows, and null until every segment is set; with TanStack Form wire value, onValueChange and onBlur to the field. A native form submits the text shown, which is the value on the 24-hour clock. hourCycle={12} adds an AM/PM segment (A and P set it). For a date use DatePicker; for a duration or a number of seconds, NumberInput.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value, "HH:mm" or "HH:mm:ss" on the 24-hour clock; null when empty or incomplete.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called when a segment changes: with the time once every segment is set, else null.

props.name: seconds
props.description: Shows and edits a seconds segment.

props.name: hourCycle
props.description: The clock shown; 12 adds an AM/PM segment. The value stays on the 24-hour clock.

props.name: minuteStep
props.description: How far ArrowUp and ArrowDown move the minutes (15 for quarter hours); typing sets any minute.

props.name: size
props.description: Control height from size.control.*, which follows data-density.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown while every segment is empty: the segments' shape by default.

props.name: name
props.description: The form field name; a Field's name wins.

props.name: required
props.description: The field must have a time before the form submits.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Ignores interaction; a Field's disabled sets it too.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Focusable and selectable, but no segment changes.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged after the component's own.

slots.name: input
slots.description: The text control, data-slot="time-picker" and data-size; its text is the segments ("14:05", "02:05 PM") with tabular figures, and the selection is always one segment.

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: Keyboard focus: a ring of ring.width in color.ring; the selected segment in color.interactive.selected.

states.name: placeholder
states.description: No segment set: the placeholder in color.fg.subtle.

states.name: invalid
states.description: In an invalid Field, or with aria-invalid: color.status.danger.border borders.

accessibility: A text input named by its FieldLabel (or aria-label) and described by FieldDescription and FieldError; its value reads as a time ("14:05", "02:05 PM").

Focus selects the hour; ArrowLeft and ArrowRight (or typing a colon) move between segments, ArrowUp and ArrowDown step the selected one and wrap, Home and End set its lowest and highest value, Backspace and Delete clear it. Tab leaves the field.
Digits fill the selected segment and move on when it is complete ("9" in the hour gives 09); A and P set AM or PM. Pasting "14:05", "2:05 pm" or "14:05:30" sets every segment.
It needs no pointer and no popup, and the shape of the time (the placeholder) shows which segments exist.
Mark it invalid through its Field, which also links the error text; required and the pattern of the segments give Base UI's Field the native validity.
